actions.label: Search Notion
actions.description: Finds pages and databases in your workspace by what you are looking for.

actions.label: Read a Notion page
actions.description: Fetches a page, database or view by its Notion link.

actions.label: List recent Notion pages
actions.description: Lists the pages you looked at most recently.

actions.label: Read a Notion page's comments
actions.description: Lists the comments and discussions on one page.

actions.label: Query a Notion database
actions.description: Reads rows out of a Notion database, filtered and sorted the way you ask.
